plain_language_summary: This candidate creates a fresh, isolated CPU-only Python environment for Experiment Three rather than copying or mutating the Experiment One environment. It fixes CPython 3.12.10, the exact observed uv 0.10.7 tool, and a 20-package Windows lock led by PyTorch 2.13.0+cpu, NumPy 2.5.1, Pillow 12.3.0, and Rasterio 1.5.0. Every installer and wheel must match the recorded hash, all custody stays under C:\Projects\Active, and any mismatch stops activation.
question: Do you approve adoption of exact runtime candidate CPYTHON-3.12.10-UV-0.10.7-TORCH-2.13.0-CPU-WINDOWS-X64-001, bound to inventory SHA-256 68f34338b61da111e0fc20a9a2a02cca7e02ff97262fd5f9d0185d351fc69f05 and private lock SHA-256 66ef4a354db2a1e51bd6ebeca81844c1f71497c1f8164e27b99816da5ce2e081, for isolated Active-only construction and synthetic Milestone 2 preflight?

allowed_decisions.yes: Authorizes download into Active-only private custody of the exact official CPython installer, Sigstore material, and hash-locked wheels; exact hash/signature verification; isolated runtime construction; exact package installation; license capture; and CPU-only import, deterministic-algorithm, and synthetic compatibility preflight. It does not authorize benchmark access or substantive training, inference, evaluation, tuning, or publication.
allowed_decisions.no: Rejects this exact candidate. No candidate artifact is downloaded or installed, and Milestone 2 remains blocked unless a different exact runtime candidate is separately proposed and approved.

grant_limits: No version substitution, dependency addition, source build, unverified artifact, or reuse of the Experiment One virtual environment.

No credential, secret, purchase, paid service, terms acceptance, administrator installation, system PATH change, launcher installation, file association, OneDrive custody, or prior-repository mutation.
No Experiment One benchmark pixel access and no substantive training, scientific checkpoint, inference, evaluation, metric, threshold, tuning, render, tag, or release.
No model-family, frozen-protocol, cohort, label, split, metric, threshold, decision-rule, or claim-envelope change.
A runtime activation mismatch or failed preflight must be retained and fail closed; approval does not imply technical success.
required_attestation: The reviewer is the Experiment Three owner and explicitly approves or rejects only the exact candidate and bounded actions above after reviewing its identity, sources, licenses, custody, risks, and exclusions.
downstream_gate: A yes permits only M2-U004 exact runtime activation and its synthetic-only validation. M2-U005 and later units remain dependency-ordered, and benchmark or scientific work remains prohibited in Milestone 2.
